market_fields_reviewed.coverage: Every quoted close, return/horizon, unit/currency and completed session checked against the current frozen card. Shanghai/Nikkei use September13; other quoted cash instruments September16; crypto September16 UTC completed daily close.

boundary_review: Microsoft September16 22:24UTC headline is before September17 cutoff and after the September16 US regular session.
Intel foundry/customer and subsidiary announcements are eligible; no regular-session move is attributed to a later publication or completed fundraising asserted.
Midea Hong Kong listing on report-date Asian trading hours remains pending at UTC midnight.
Fed September18 and BOJ September meeting outcomes remain pending; survey expectations retain labels.
China tariff/export-control announcements remain reported policies, with no unsupported future settlement or election outcome.
Sourceage by meaning:company news7d/results14d/current macro or policy35d. No excluded source cited.

validation.nonretail_render: Shared renderer Doc helper rendered every paragraph and resolved every final citation.

preservation: Only named nonretail strings changed by loading current spec. retail and retail_intro JSON values preserved exactly. No frozen source/card changes, publishing or git operations.
limits: This is an AI editorial review of frozen headline-level evidence, not an independent audit of complete article bodies, private trading records or publisher archives.

Approximate indexed publication times do not certify original publication vintage. High-risk future outcomes are omitted; boundary-aged company-result references are omitted when their eligibility cannot be established confidently from the permitted evidence.
Retrospectively retrieved market cards may include vendor corrections; the review verifies the briefing against those frozen cards and does not certify an original unrevised price-history vintage.
The nonretail component hash binds this review. Later retail-only merges change the full-spec hash but do not invalidate unchanged nonretail content.
